title: Missing From<JmapError> for RequestError
description: request_error(err: JmapError) exists as a free function but there is no From<JmapError> for RequestError impl. Callers writing glue code that propagates JMAP errors cannot use the ? operator to convert a JmapError into a RequestError. They must call request_error(e) explicitly at every call site. A From impl would enable e.into() and ? propagation in Result<_, RequestError> functions.
